issues.body: Sections 6–9 say phases 1–4 are unblocked today, yet the PR intentionally supplies none of the bead's requested wiring: no pinned fetch script, vector reader, encoder, stratified oracle test, or ratcheted floor. The central 19/19 result was obtained with an out-of-tree probe and borrowed JavaScript encoder, so neither that result nor the security-critical assertion that the four-stratum path avoids a fail-open decision is reproducible or gated by this repository. A design record alone is not a complete implementation of the stated conformance-vector task.
issues.fix_hint: Implement at least the self-contained phases 1–4 in this change or retitle/rescope the PR and its bead explicitly as a design-only prerequisite. For implementation, add the pinned fetch path, strict manifest/encoder handling, a real `reason_n3_stratified` test over all 19 evaluate-access vectors, a regression/mutation witness proving the naive single-pass path fails on the two deny cases, and the monotone conformance floor described by the record.
issues.title: The PR documents but does not implement the unblocked conformance work

verdict.summary: The research is careful and the lib.rs correction remains appropriately caveated, but the change is incomplete against its stated bead: it explicitly delivers no fetcher, manifest harness, encoder, oracle test, or conformance floor even though it concludes phases 1–4 are unblocked. The key 19/19 access-decision claim is supported only by an out-of-tree, uncommitted probe, so there is no reproducible in-repository test of the load-bearing fail-closed stratification invariant.
